marca-agua.title: Watermark
marca-agua.description: Add a text watermark to your PDF or image in seconds. Free, no account, and the file never leaves your browser.
marca-agua.cta: Need to watermark hundreds of documents or photos every week? We can build that automation for you.
marca-agua.seoTitle: Add a Free Watermark to PDF or Image | SonhoLab
marca-agua.seoDescription: Add a text watermark to your PDF or image for free. Adjust opacity and size, then download instantly. Everything runs in your browser, no upload needed.
marca-agua.intro: Before sharing a draft contract, a photo proof set, or a floor plan that hasn't been approved yet, it helps to make clear it's not the final version. This tool adds text like Confidential, Draft, or your company name, repeated diagonally across the whole page or image so it stays visible no matter where someone looks or tries to crop it out. It works with both PDF files and JPG, PNG, or WEBP images, automatically detecting the file type. Adjust the opacity and font size with simple sliders and download the result. Everything happens in your browser: the file never gets uploaded to any server.
marca-agua.stepsHeading: How to add a watermark in 3 steps
marca-agua.step1Text: Drag the file into the upload area or select it from your device. The tool automatically detects whether it's a PDF or a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image, and within seconds it's ready for you to set the watermark text.
marca-agua.step2Title: Type your text and adjust the style
marca-agua.step2Text: Type the word or phrase you want repeated, like Confidential, Draft, or your company name, and move the opacity and font size sliders until the watermark is clear without fully hiding the content underneath.
marca-agua.step3Text: Hit download and the PDF or image with the diagonal watermark pattern saves to your device. The original file stays untouched, so you can try different text, sizes, and opacity levels until you get the result you want.
marca-agua.useCase1: A freelancer sends a draft contract to a client and marks it Draft so it's clear the terms can still change before the final version, avoiding confusion if it gets forwarded by mistake.
marca-agua.useCase2: A photographer shares session proofs with a watermark so the client can review and pick favorites without being able to use the photos until they pay and get the clean file.
marca-agua.useCase3: A real estate agent marks a property's floor plan as Preliminary before the project gets the client's final approval, making it clear the measurements can still change.
marca-agua.faq1q: Can I use my logo as a watermark instead of text?
marca-agua.faq1a: Not right now. The tool only supports typed text, like your company name or a word such as Confidential. It doesn't let you upload an image or logo to use as the mark, so if you need that exact logo stamped on, you'd have to combine it with another image editing tool. If you need something more advanced or automated, that's a separate build we can talk through.
marca-agua.faq2q: Does the watermark appear once, or does it repeat across the page?
marca-agua.faq2a: It repeats diagonally across the whole page or image in a tiled pattern, not as a single stamp in one corner. That makes it harder to crop out or cover with another element, but it also means it visually covers a good part of the document, so it's worth adjusting the opacity so the original content stays readable.
marca-agua.faq3q: What happens to my file when I add the watermark?
marca-agua.faq3a: Nothing leaves your device. The PDF is processed with the pdf-lib library and the image with the browser's Canvas, both running directly on your own computer, so the file never travels to our servers or anyone else's.
marca-agua.faq4q: Does it work with JPG and PNG images, or only PDF?
marca-agua.faq4a: It works with both. Upload a PDF or a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image and the tool automatically detects the file type to apply the watermark correctly. Video files aren't supported.
marca-agua.faq5q: Is it free, and do I need to create an account?
marca-agua.faq5a: It's free and doesn't ask for an account or an email. You can watermark one file or twenty in the same day, with no limit, because all the processing runs in your browser instead of on any server of ours.
